b.x: The doctrine is in the field App risk.
01 Where did this app come from? The official store of the account I use. No APK. The store, but a new page, few reviews, a name like the famous one. A forum APK, a link, a group, a ‘pro version’.

02 Does the app’s job ask for what it asks? Yes. A torch lights. A map uses the map. A call uses the mic at the time. Almost. One ask is extra and I do not know why. Weather asks for contacts. A torch asks for SMS. Wallpaper asks for location always.
03 Location: how is it set? Denied, or only while using, if the job is a map/run. Always on ‘just in case’. It can be tightened. Always. Background. And it still shares in a message.
04 Camera and microphone? Only the photo app and the call app, at the time. The rest, no. One extra I have not revoked. A game, a torch or a ‘utility’ with mic and camera on.
05 Contacts, SMS, calls? No. Or only the phone / the messenger, if that is the job. It asked. I accepted to ‘continue’. It reads SMS (the bank code) or the whole book without being a messenger.

06 Who publishes this app? A name I recognise. A site. The same mark as the bank / map / messenger. Unknown, but the store shows years and a lot of people. Free VPN, ‘cleaner’, ‘hack’, a copied name, no history.

07 Does it demand an account, tracking, or social login? It works without an account, or the account is the service (bank, messenger). It asks for Google/Apple to ‘make it easy’. I can refuse. It will not open without login. And the login maps the book and photos.

08 Does Tuesday live without this app? Tuesday lives without it. If the permission is fair, either way; if not, it goes. It helps. It is not the bank or the house messenger. It is the messenger, the bank or the family’s map. Then the risk is permission, not deletion.

09 Does it work alone in the background? No. It opens, does the job, closes. No eternal notification. It sometimes wakes. Background can be restricted. Always awake, eats battery, sends data, asks to ignore battery saver.

10 Would you leave this app, with these permissions, on the child’s or the elder’s phone? Yes. The slice is fair. I can explain why. On mine, it stays. On theirs, I would tighten it. No. If it is not fit for them, it is not fit for the house’s map.
